svg.title: Under-2000 upstairs Version C: finished laundry and storage over the garage, no unfinished space
svg.desc: Preliminary furnished diagram, not an implemented model. Version C finishes the area over the garage east of the laundry instead of adding unfinished attic. Laundry (11.1 by 8 feet clear, wraparound counters, 48-inch aisle) and a finished storage room (11.1 by 5 feet) move into an 11.5-foot east wing aligned with the garage east wall, between the Bedroom 2 line and the Bath 4 line. A 3-foot-2-inch hall runs from the gallery to the laundry. Bath 2 (9 by 5 feet) and Closet 2 (about 4 feet 1 inch by 5 feet) move south of Bedroom 2 into the former laundry location, so the former north Bath 2 / Closet 2 strip is removed. Bedroom 2 becomes about 14 feet 8 inches by 11 feet 11 inches. The primary bath bump-out is trimmed 3.5 feet, leaving about 13 feet 7 inches by 10 feet with toilet room, two 48-inch vanities, a 60-inch tub and a two-person 84 by 42-inch shower with two heads along the east wall. Mechanical stays at 6 by 5 feet off the hall. No bedroom is over the garage. Exterior-face gross area including walls and descending stairs, less the actual stair gap, is 1,988.83 square feet. Structure over the garage span, garage fire separation, roof, HVAC, plumbing and products remain unverified.
svg.text: Version C: finished rooms over the garage, no attic, under 2,000
PRELIMINARY DIAGRAM ONLY | 1,988.83 sq ft finished gross | Laundry + storage over garage | 3D model unchanged
Rear / north at top; street / front at bottom. Plan geometry is to scale. Room sizes are approximate painted-face dimensions.

g.text: HALL to laundry, 3 ft 2 in clear
Laundry + finished storage go over the garage,
filling your marked area to the garage east wall.
Bath 2 / Closet 2 take the old laundry spot;
a 3 ft 2 in hall reaches the new laundry.
Same open gallery: all four bedroom doors visible.
No bedroom over the garage; furnace room unchanged.
Bedroom 2: 14 ft 8 in x 11 ft 11 in (was ~14 ft 8 in x 14 ft 5 in).
Closet 2: 4 ft 1 in x 5 ft, 8 ft of double-hang rod.
Primary bath: 13 ft 7 in x 10 ft (was 13 ft 6 in deep);
2-person 84 x 42 shower (2 heads), tub, 2 vanities, WC.
Laundry: 11 ft 1 in x 8 ft, 48-in counter aisle.
North side of Bedroom 2 becomes exterior wall (windows possible).
Dashed amber: door sweeps / appliance zones.
Area check: below 2,000 sq ft gross
Version A / B finished gross: 1,985.78 sq ft
Everything is finished space; no unfinished attic.
Wing walls cross the garage span: beams, floor loads and
garage fire separation require professional review.

svg.text: Generic study footprints, not selected products. Static fit is not occupied-use approval; door swings, fixture spacing and storage capacity need review.
Over-garage floor, roof/headroom, fire separation, HVAC and plumbing require professional review. This diagram does not approve construction.
